description: React component 'CanvasNode' for rendering and managing a node in a visual canvas, including UI interactions, dialogs, and node state management.

methods.name: getNodeInfoOpenStatus
methods.description: Determines whether the node info dialog should be open based on current state.

methods.name: nodeOutdatedMessage
methods.description: Generates a warning message indicating the node version is outdated.

methods.name: nodeVersionEmptyMessage
methods.description: Generates a warning message when node version information is missing.

methods.name: onDialogClicked
methods.description: Prepares and opens the dialog for additional node parameters.

methods.name: getBorderColor
methods.description: Returns border color based on node selection and theme mode.
